summary: react-fontawesome-icons exfiltrates document.cookie to hardcoded attacker host on render
details: The default-exported React component in this package unconditionally performs an axios.get to http://command.control and an axios.post to http://commad.control/404 with document.cookie and a constructed payload whenever the component is mounted. A font-awesome icon component has no legitimate reason to contact a remote host or transmit browser cookies. Cover-story naming (a function named not_ma_li_ci_ous_at_all, a helper constructData) and a commented base64 blob decoding to a CTF flag string accompany the exfil call, indicating intentional malicious or proof-of-concept behavior. Any web application that ships this component will leak its users' cookies to the hardcoded destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
